trust_decision.summary: Whether a document save triggered by a Live Data cell edit is allowed: ModelBridge.saveDocument must run the user-save rights check before XWiki#saveDocument, because XWiki#saveDocument itself performs no authorization check and the existing authorization.checkAccess(Right.EDIT) in update/updateAll does not cover edits to XWikiRights objects. Without the check a user who only has edit right can add or modify an XWiki.XWikiRights object through Live Data and grant themselves script right (or any right they do not hold); the fix calls XWiki#checkSavingDocument, whose UserUpdatingDocumentEvent is handled by RightsFilterListener, which checks each modified right and cancels the unauthorized rights-object change.

landing_point.why: ModelBridge.saveDocument is the only document save in the Live Data feature; an engineer who greps the module for 'save' lands here and sees a bare xcontext.getWiki().saveDocument(document, "LiveData update.", true, xcontext) with no user-save check, right after the token authorization.checkAccess(Right.EDIT, documentReference) at lines 124/181 that looks like the protection.

fix_sites.entry_point: PUT /rest/livedata/{sourceId}/.../entries/{entryId}/properties/{propertyId} (DefaultLiveDataEntryPropertyResource.setProperty -> LiveTableLiveDataEntryStore.update -> ModelBridge.update) and PUT .../entries/{entryId} / POST .../entries (DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.updateEntry / DefaultLiveDataEntriesResource.addEntry -> LiveTableLiveDataEntryStore.save -> ModelBridge.updateAll)
fix_sites.module_kind: internal component of the Live Data live-table connector (xwiki-platform-livedata-livetable), reached from the Live Data REST module and, through it, from the Live Data macro UI

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a - no O2 site and no O8 route: every Live Data write funnels through the one private saveDocument, so the published fix closes all of them at once.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate rights administration and normal editing through Live Data must keep working: a user who actually holds the right being added/removed (e.g. an admin editing the Levels column of an XWikiRights object) and any user editing ordinary columns, title, content, hidden or enforceRequiredRights must still be saved. An over-broad fix - refusing all XWiki.XWikiRights column edits, or refusing any save whose page contains script - breaks these legitimate edits; the correct check only cancels the unauthorized rights-object modification.

O6_input_shapes: single property with a plain String value: PUT .../entries/{entryId}/properties/{propertyId} -> ModelBridge.update(property, value, documentReference, classReference, 0) (DefaultLiveDataEntryPropertyResource.java:63-87, ModelBridge.java:100-139)

whole entry as Map<String,Object> (one or many properties at once): PUT .../entries/{entryId} and POST .../entries -> LiveTableLiveDataEntryStore.save -> ModelBridge.updateAll (DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.java:71-100, DefaultLiveDataEntriesResource.java:83-107, ModelBridge.java:177-202)

list-valued (multi-select) properties such as Levels, converted to String[] by updateXObject (ModelBridge.java:310-314), including per-property XClass mapping via <property>_class parameters (LiveTableLiveDataEntryStore.java:178-181 and 263-271)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Implement the interface's default remove(Object entryId) (LiveDataEntryStore.java:114) so a Live Data row delete deletes the mapped document with xwiki.deleteDocument(...) directly, without the user-delete check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Live Data tables already expose row actions and DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.deleteEntry (DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.java:102-117) already calls entryStore.remove; a maintainer adding row deletion to the live-table source would naturally implement remove() with a direct deleteDocument call, while the sibling check XWiki#checkDeletingDocument (XWiki.java:4683, used by DeleteAction.java:246) also feeds RightsFilterListener via UserDeletingDocumentEvent (RightsFilterListener.java:81).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second LiveDataEntryStore that persists its edits by loading an XWiki document and calling xwiki.saveDocument(...) from inside the entry store, instead of going through ModelBridge.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The extension-security Live Data already edits persisted security configuration and the notifications/extension-security entry stores are the obvious places a maintainer would add persisted settings; a save there bypasses ModelBridge (the only place the fix puts the check) and would need the same checkXxx call, so the fix must be understood as 'every Live Data document save must call the user-save check', not as 'patch ModelBridge'.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization - user-driven document save skips the required-rights/rights-modification check, giving edit-to-script privilege escalation

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module reactor; root pom org.xwiki.platform:xwiki-platform 18.1.0-SNAPSHOT whose parent org.xwiki.commons:xwiki-commons-pom 18.1.0-SNAPSHOT is not vendored (pom.xml:23-44), so the exact JDK release is not declared in this tree; module under test xwiki-platform-livedata-livetable (jar)
O10_build.project_tests: ModelBridgeTest and LiveTableLiveDataEntryStoreTest (Mockito @ComponentTest, no container) in xwiki-platform-livedata-livetable; the regression test the fix adds is a Selenium UI test, LiveDataIT.savingChecksRights, in xwiki-platform-livedata-test-docker (needs a running XWiki and a browser); xwiki-platform-test-integration exists for in-process integration tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add another ContextualAuthorizationManager check beside the existing authorization.checkAccess(Right.EDIT) in update/updateAll (try Right.SCRIPT or Right.PROGRAM), or hand-roll a check of the XWikiRights Levels values, instead of calling XWiki#checkSavingDocument so that RightsFilterListener runs.

out_of_scope_notes: Not this advisory's protection: DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.updateEntry (xwiki-platform-livedata-rest/.../DefaultLiveDataEntryResource.java:71-100) saves a whole entry without the isEditable guard that DefaultLiveDataEntryPropertyResource.setProperty applies (DefaultLiveDataEntryPropertyResource.java:70-76); noted, not pursued.

Not this advisory's protection: XWiki#saveDocument (xwiki-platform-oldcore/.../XWiki.java:2031) performs no user-save check at all, and many programmatic callers across the platform rely on it; out of the Live Data scope, not pursued.
